claims.claim: Unsupervised SimCSE uses independently sampled standard dropout as the sole augmentation for a positive sentence pair
claims.verification_note: Same text, two encoder passes and distinct dropout masks.

claims.claim: Supervised SimCSE uses NLI entailment as positives and contradiction as hard negatives
claims.verification_note: Neutral is not universally treated as contradiction.

claims.claim: Batch contrastive softmax uses positives and in-batch negatives with a temperature parameter
claims.verification_note: Single-direction concept equation; real pipeline may differ in batch organization.

claims.claim: Unsupervised BERT base and supervised BERT base reported 76.3 and 81.6 averaged STS Spearman scores
claims.verification_note: These are mean Spearman correlation scores, not accuracy.

claims.claim: Sentence embedding alignment and uniformity are geometric analysis concepts
claims.verification_note: Two-dimensional diagram is independent toy visualization.

claims.claim: Official SimCSE implementation offers unsup/sup variants and pooling choices
claims.verification_note: Pooling/head handling depends on checkpoint and task.
